entries.172bf9e9a56749c6: This is a business that sells, at the request of customers wishing to introduce XNET services, the computers and other equipment needed for their use. It is limited to customers introducing XNET services and is not conducted on its own. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7 million.
entries.6c566dea20338720: This is a service that provides, for a monthly usage fee, systems supporting the practical side of asset management, such as securities order receipt and placement (front office), performance analysis and beneficiary reporting (middle office), and journal entries, deposits and withdrawals, and custody of physical assets (back office). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,980 million.
entries.b3c45317996d40b2: This is the company's single segment. The core offering is "XNET Service," an information system for asset management that the company developed in-house and that multiple customers use jointly for a monthly service fee; revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, including equipment sales and similar, was ¥5,658 million.
entries.e3fadd2eef84621e: A company that develops in-house core asset management systems used by institutional investors and financial institutions, and provides the "XNET Service", which multiple customers share for a monthly fee.
entries.e416f9a23c698594: AMO is a service in which dedicated staff support customers, from the customer's standpoint, in operating and maintaining the XNET application and in its design and development. SO (Smart Outsourcing Service) is a service in which the company uses XNET services to perform on behalf of institutional investors the business operations themselves, such as accounting and clerical work. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 from AMO and SO combined was ¥1,669 million.
